purpose: Prevent metadata wrappers or re-hosted views of the same acoustic origin from inflating source-diversity credit.

fsd50k-1.0.note: FSD50K clips originate from Freesound; direct Freesound acquisition of the same sound is not a second source family.

rules: Source diversity is counted by underlying acoustic-origin family, not wrapper/dataset name.
The same SHA-256 or same upstream sound identity can never receive multiple source-family credits.
Synthetic/reference-only sources never receive independent real-source credit.
When a stronger recording/session relationship becomes known, grouping must be upgraded and downstream evidence rerun.
